P.text: User calls queueWithdrawal providing kHYPE shares to redeem, which are converted to HYPE via stakingAccountant::kHYPEToHYPE using on-chain exchange rate information.
P.evidence_quote: When withdrawing from the `StakingManager`, users provide `kHYPE` shares to be redeemed, which is converted to an equivalent `HYPE` amount using on-chain informations.

I.text: User should be able to specify/expect a minimum HYPE amount (slippage protection) so the received amount is not worse than expected.
I.evidence_quote: This means that a user can queue a withdrawal and receive less `HYPE` than he was expecting when sending the transaction (e.g if slashing happens).

V.text: No slippage protection exists on queueWithdrawal; if slashing is reported right before the user's tx executes, the exchange rate worsens and the user receives less HYPE than expected, causing direct loss of funds.
V.evidence_quote: If a slashing is reported right before the user `queueWithdrawal` tx is executed, he will suffer a worse exchange rate than expected, without any ways for him to prevent this.
